notes.title: Dev Update - Thrilling New Sensations Await
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/833d0894cb926a33fb0980d0ed9ca6d6134c1d9f.jpg

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/fb426b2ec650981b5a9109c4f04c25de9d19721b.jpg

This time, in Light of a New Day, you will be able to marry your most beloved ladies Xinyi, Himari, and Fumi. Get ready to take on unique and playful challenges, each one designed to test your commitment and charm.

Xinyi comes from a traditional family in China, and as your relationship deepens, her family will question your intentions for her future. Himari, a girl of prestige and status, will require unwavering dedication and care not only to herself but also to her closest family members. Finally, Fumi is a strong-willed woman who won’t settle for simply being your devoted secretary.

Each wedding celebrates a unique culture, offering you intriguing insights. The ladies will be breathtaking in their traditional wedding attire, making each a true goddess to behold. Will you prove yourself as the perfect match for these beautiful ladies? Discover what it takes to win their hearts!

🔥Enjoy an upgraded living space and experience sensational new interactions:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/d594a333b92b40c37b4198c6d0a54a2f81ae6a9f.gif
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/0590400de105982d65173073bea51ce2805cb18e.gif

🔥New prestigious decorations to complement your beautiful new house:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/6899ceafd2a128acf7fb5e594d851b34ca1d0152.gif

🔥And of course, after all the devotion, courage, and warmth you’ve put forth, what do you think awaits you as a reward?
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/d460c851402078c7f1f9c82dce8aabc1b2e3ea51.gif

Wishlist Light of a New Day now! Your well-earned blessings are waiting just for you!
